newsitem.title: USA: May Dept Stores March same-store sales flat.
newsitem.headline: May Dept Stores March same-store sales flat.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Thursday its comparable store sales in March were even with those of the same month last year.
Total sales for the five weeks ended April 5, 1997 rose 5.7 percent to $1.01 billion from $953 million in the same period a year ago.
Sales were hurt by the loss of one weekend selling day, as Easter Sunday fell in fiscal March 1997 versus fiscal April last year, the retailer said in a monthly statement.
May said sales for the first two months of fiscal 1997 were $1.75 billion, up 7.1 percent over the $1.63 billion during the first two months of fiscal 1996.

Sales have been restated to exclude sales of stores that have been closed and not replaced. Year-to-date revenues, including sales of nonreplaced closed stores and finance charge revenue, were $1.81 billion in 1997 and $1.71 billion in 1996.
During the month, May opened two new stores. The company currently operates 366 department stores in 30 states and the District of Columbia.
